extracted.summary: NSP Merit Cum Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minorities) provides financial assistance to minority community students pursuing technical or professional courses at the undergraduate or postgraduate level.
extracted.amount_text: INR 20,000 per annum subject to actual whichever is less, for both Hostellers and Day Scholars.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have secured at least 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous final examination.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual family income of less than INR 2.50 lakhs from all sources.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to Minority communities (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Jain, and Parsis/Zoroastrians).
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be pursuing a technical or professional course at the undergraduate or postgraduate level from a recognized institution.
